name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-06-21, at wavelengths from 0.91 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
